claims.assertion: The October 26 edition identified an upcoming October 27-28 FOMC meeting, not the eventual policy outcome.
The October 27 Daily reiterated the scheduled decision date without anticipating the policy vote.
The Federal Reserve maintained the 3.75%-4.00% target range by a 10-2 vote; two officials preferred a 25-basis-point increase.

claims.observationPeriod: Q3 2026 real GDP, seasonally adjusted annual rate; Q2 comparison
claims.assertion: BEA's October 29 advance estimate recorded 3.4% annualized Q3 real GDP growth, compared with 2.2% in Q2; the reference period is a quarter, not October 30.
BEA's September PCE release, published October 29, reported headline inflation at 3.6% year over year and core inflation at 3.1% year over year.

claims.observationPeriod: Q3 2026 Employment Cost Index, q/q SA and 12-month NSA
claims.assertion: BLS reported Q3 civilian compensation growth of 0.8% quarter over quarter, seasonally adjusted, versus 0.9% in Q2, and 3.4% over 12 months, not seasonally adjusted.

sections.heading: What happened and when
sections.text: Separate the October 26-27 calendar previews from the October 28 FOMC outcome and the October 29 GDP/PCE and October 30 ECI releases.

sections.heading: Why it matters for dollar transmission
sections.text: Policy-rate expectations, real yields and risk appetite are conditional transmission channels, not evidence of an observed DXY or cross-asset move in this week's official releases.

sections.heading: Data units and source integrity
sections.text: Keep GDP annualized quarterly growth separate from monthly PCE price changes, and quarterly seasonally adjusted ECI separate from 12-month unadjusted ECI.
